description: React component for managing and displaying the UI for adding channel members in Mattermost, including handling mentions, invite links, and policy enforcement messaging.

classes.name: PostAddChannelMember
classes.description: React component class for adding members to a channel, handling mentions, and displaying related UI.

methods.name: handleAddChannelMember
methods.description: Handles adding selected users to the channel and sending ephemeral posts.

methods.name: expand
methods.description: Expands the mention list to show all users.

methods.name: generateAtMentions
methods.description: Generates JSX elements for user mentions, handling different display cases based on number of users.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the component UI, including mention links, invite options, and policy enforcement messages.
